title: The Induction
description: A chapter about the one flag a player carries alone: a stage. One quest
grants one, one is gated on it, and one takes it away again -- the whole
of the feature, written out in three files.
A stage is per player rather than per team, so the middle quest here is
open to a marked player and locked to an unmarked one even while they
share progress. That is the difference worth reading the files for: a
dependency gates a team, and a stage gates a person.
